title: Common Foot and Ankle Injuries: What Not to Miss and How Best to Manage.
journal: The Journal of the American Osteopathic Association

sections.label: UNLABELED
sections.text: Injuries to the foot and ankle are commonly encountered, especially among athletes, and can lead to morbidity if not managed appropriately. Health care professionals must have a firm understanding of injury anatomy, diagnoses, and management. This article provides a review of lateral talus process fractures, os trigonum injuries, Lisfranc injuries, turf toe, navicular stress fractures, and syndesmotic injuries.
